hooks.name: check-handoff-staleness
hooks.description: Verify the Product Handoff is still current before implementation work begins on an SDD change.
hooks.notes: Staleness is judged only by the digests of referenced artifacts; unrelated repository activity never blocks.

hooks.name: validate-before-handoff
hooks.description: Ensure the baseline and the Product Change overlay validate before a handoff is generated.
hooks.notes: A handoff generated from an invalid overlay would package broken product knowledge; this hook blocks on deterministic failure.

hooks.name: validate-product-change
hooks.description: Validate the product model after product files are edited, and the affected Product Change overlay before it is approved or sliced.
hooks.notes: Hooks run deterministic commands only. They never approve a change, approve a slice, promote, edit product semantics, create backlog items or archive SDD work.

hooks.name: verify-traceability
hooks.description: Verify every implemented product requirement has coverage evidence before SDD change closure, and dry-run the promotion before a Product Change is promoted.
hooks.notes: The dry run reports the plan; executing the promotion remains an explicit human action and is never performed by a hook.
